title: Shared provider runtime and Sourceright extraction
claim_boundary: Locally compiler-tested Searchright implementation and a read-only Sourceright baseline, retained at the repository-wide source-verified ceiling until exact-revision CI evidence exists. The additive core-owned subrequest context has 74 focused native tests and strict Clippy passing; full validation for this slice and live-adapter adoption remain pending. Registry-local cooperative admission is not process-wide rate enforcement or current provider-policy approval; no live provider, downstream integration, dual-run, SemVer, rollback, release or archival claim is made.

assertions.statement: Inventory Sourceright live_providers and provider modules
assertions.permitted_claim: The current Sourceright provider surface is inventoried at a pinned revision and its provider blobs are unchanged from the original inventory.

assertions.statement: Define compatibility adapter and feature flag
assertions.permitted_claim: The compatibility adapter is compiler-tested in Searchright; downstream feature integration is not performed.

assertions.statement: Port retries, cache, endpoint, rate and receipt behavior
open_gates: Obtain exact-revision compiler CI and transport-level adversarial evidence for resolve-validate-pin behavior, proxy suppression, redirects and response bounds.
Prove cache and error parity against Sourceright.
Complete full validation of the additive subrequest-context slice and adopt it in each live adapter before claiming per-HTTP admission; legacy defaults still admit one page, not hidden HTTP calls.
assertions.permitted_claim: The shared runtime and resolve-validate-pin live transport pass local compiler tests. The nonserialized core page context and explicit registry-local rate groups pass 16 focused subrequest tests plus 58 core unit tests and strict Clippy. Admission, shared floors, cooperative deadlines/cancellation and cumulative subrequest bounds are fixture-tested; legacy timeout tightening is deliberate. This slice has no live-adapter adoption and full validation remains pending; current provider-policy compliance, CI, Sourceright parity and opt-in live execution are not proven.

assertions.statement: Run old/new fixture parity and snapshot differences
open_gates: Validate a complete provider/fixture/case/dimension execution matrix and run old/new fixtures; v1 summary readiness alone is not execution proof.
assertions.permitted_claim: Parity cases are defined; dual-run results do not yet exist.

open_gates: Run cargo-semver-checks and public API snapshots after compiler bootstrap.
assertions.permitted_claim: SemVer and public API gates are configured but not executed.

assertions.statement: Switch Sourceright then remove superseded code after evidence
open_gates: Modify and test Sourceright through an approved downstream pull request.
Retain rollback for at least one compatible release.
assertions.permitted_claim: No Sourceright code has been removed or switched by this repository.
